provenance.source: USGS National Land Cover Database 2021: land cover and percent developed imperviousness (CONUS)
provenance.query: WCS 2.0.1 GetCoverage (land cover and impervious) per frame, EPSG:4326 output, nearest-neighbour, format=text/plain, e.g. https://www.mrlc.gov/geoserver/ows?service=WCS&version=2.0.1&request=GetCoverage&coverageId=mrlc_download__NLCD_2021_Impervious_L48&subset=Long(w,e)&subset=Lat(s,n)
provenance.method: Raw 30 m class codes and impervious percent per cell, reprojected by the server to EPSG:4326. Reference fractions are computed in code from cells whose centres fall inside each bounding box.
caveats: NLCD is itself a remote-sensing product with its own error; agreement is with a reference, not with ground truth.
Epoch 2021; scans are 2026. Buildings and pavement are not separable.
Class code 0 marks cells outside the reprojected coverage and is ignored.
